cells.gaps: The 97 digitised hospital-based registration points (TCD-016) have no total of local offices beside them, so the count is a floor and no share is established; deaths are not registered digitally on any fact. `made` disagrees: N'Djamena's commune service is still described as paper on 2026-09-23 (TCD-001, TCD-004) and the national system as predominantly paper in 2024 (TCD-019), while the hospital offices are connected (TCD-017, TCD-044); the commune facts are one municipality and do not carry the country. TCD-017's words do not say the entry is made at the office, which only TCD-044 says, of six hospitals in 2023. No admitted source states a rural gap, and the N'Djamena register digitisation is planned, not under way.
cells.note: Births are registered digitally at hospital-based registry offices past the 2023 pilot, 97 points and more than 120,000 children by June 2025, sent to ANATS and returned for issuance. Stage 4 needs more than half of local offices on a share or a count with a denominator, and none is given.
